comment: The runs of names that the code builds at run time (StringName("log_entry_%d" % n)): kind -> prefix -> the numbers that must exist (first..last, except the listed missing ones). test_code_names.py compares them with names/original.json and with the patterns found in godot/src; rename_name.py --run renames a whole run and keeps this file in step. Hand-made, committed.
